name: Follow the Bot
description:
The Griffith University cybersecurity investigation has now traced the suspicious ticket traffic to the Starlight Arena ticket server.

Your team recovered the server access log from the same 90-second sale window.

## Your Mission

Analyse `access.log` and determine which account was repeatedly performing automated ticket actions.

Basic Linux commands such as `grep`, `sort`, and `uniq` may be useful.

Submit the suspicious username using the `GRIFFITH{...}` flag format.

Example:

`username123` → `GRIFFITH{username123}`

hints.title: Hint 1: Trace the Suspicious Source
hints.content: Look through the sale-window access log and focus on the account that repeatedly performs successful purchase actions.

hints.title: Hint 2: Count the Repeated Account
hints.content: Compare the usernames. Commands such as grep, sort and uniq -c can help reveal which account appears over and over.
